name: gaep-kiro
description: Governed local Product Studio, agent-readiness, selection, versioned handoff, managed read-only execution/evidence, exact staged review, and portable-design workflows for Kiro.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: GAEP for Kiro can show its static Product Studio boundary, but it does not inspect Product, Initiative entry, or Managed Run state, start the local engine, classify/resolve an Initiative, run managed read-only work, review/apply/discard staged changes, or import/read/list portable design metadata until the workspace is trusted.

gaepKiro.engineExecutable.description: Optional machine-scoped external GAEP engine executable name or absolute path. Empty uses the package-local digest-bound engine. Workspace overrides are rejected.

gaepKiro.engineSha256.description: Optional machine-scoped SHA-256 pin for an explicitly configured external GAEP engine executable. It is rejected when the package-local engine is selected. Workspace overrides are rejected.

gaepKiro.actorId.description: Portable human actor ID recorded for local imports, guarded agent selections, versioned handoffs, and exact staged apply/discard decisions. It cannot contain credentials and workspace overrides are ignored.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o dist/gaep-kiro.vsix
scripts.test:extension-host: npm --prefix ../.. run build --workspace @gaep/engine && npm run test:extension-contract && npm run package && npm run verify:package && node test/e2e/run.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:extension-contract && npm run package && npm run verify:package && npm run test:package-contract
